title: The method "beforeStoppingVertx" in Launcher has not been invoked.

comments.body:
> Is anything beforeStartingVertx printed to the logs?

Yes, it is. Here is part of my application logs:

```
20:10:03.156 [main] INFO  c.t.friendship.FriendshipLauncher - beforeStartingVertx
20:10:03.412 [main] INFO  c.t.friendship.FriendshipLauncher - afterStartingVertx
20:10:03.938 [vert.x-eventloop-thread-2] INFO  com.zaxxer.hikari.HikariDataSource - HikariPool-1 - Starting...
20:10:04.104 [vert.x-eventloop-thread-2] INFO  com.zaxxer.hikari.HikariDataSource - HikariPool-1 - Start completed.
20:10:04.692 [vert.x-eventloop-thread-0] INFO  i.v.c.i.l.c.VertxIsolatedDeployer - Succeeded in deploying verticle
20:10:04.728 [vert.x-eventloop-thread-3] INFO  c.t.friendship.component.GRPCServer - start warm up application
20:10:04.759 [vert.x-eventloop-thread-3] INFO  c.t.friendship.component.GRPCServer - warm up completed, cost 30ms
20:10:22.709 [vert.x-worker-thread-18] INFO  com.zaxxer.hikari.HikariDataSource - HikariPool-1 - Shutdown initiated...
20:10:22.717 [vert.x-worker-thread-18] INFO  com.zaxxer.hikari.HikariDataSource - HikariPool-1 - Shutdown completed.
20:10:22.830 [Thread-5] INFO  c.t.friendship.FriendshipLauncher - afterStoppingVertx
```

And in fact it is pretty easy to reproduce, just make a starter application from [start.vertx.io](https://start.vertx.io/), then add some logs. Everything works well if simply run, but add some Java heap variables like `-Xmx100m -Xms100m` to limit memory size, the issue appears.

I have made a demo project, [here](https://github.com/cyhii/vertx-starter-demo)

Steps: 
`./gradlew shadowJar`

`java -Xmx100m -Xms100m -jar build/libs/starter-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT-fat.jar`
(or make the heap size more smaller)

Logs in my Laptop:

```
$ java -Xmx100m -Xms100m -jar build/libs/starter-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT-fat.jar
20:33:01.562 [main] INFO  com.example.starter.MyLauncher - beforeStartingVertx
20:33:01.660 [main] INFO  com.example.starter.MyLauncher - afterStartingVertx
20:33:01.798 [vert.x-eventloop-thread-0] INFO  i.v.c.i.l.c.VertxIsolatedDeployer - Succeeded in deploying verticle



^C20:33:02.953 [Thread-2] INFO  com.example.starter.MyLauncher - afterStoppingVertx
```

```
$ java -Xmx300m -Xms300m -jar build/libs/starter-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT-fat.jar
20:33:11.037 [main] INFO  com.example.starter.MyLauncher - beforeStartingVertx
20:33:11.135 [main] INFO  com.example.starter.MyLauncher - afterStartingVertx
20:33:11.240 [vert.x-eventloop-thread-0] INFO  i.v.c.i.l.c.VertxIsolatedDeployer - Succeeded in deploying verticle

^C20:33:12.172 [Thread-2] INFO  com.example.starter.MyLauncher - beforeStoppingVertx
20:33:12.194 [Thread-2] INFO  com.example.starter.MyLauncher - afterStoppingVertx
```
